gloss_en: Script flags properties in an IFC not required by the IDS; is it worthwhile to demand only requested data?

answer_summary: Replies split: extra data can be fallback vs. redundant data conflicts with required data and breaks single source of truth; poster prefers receiving only what is requested.

gloss_en: Want an IDS rule that fails if any IfcBuildingElementProxy exists and lists the offenders

answer_summary: GlobalId is mandatory on rooted entities so that requirement is redundant; maintainer said report clarity of failing entities was fixed.

gloss_en: Need to check ~70 models against 6 IDS files every two weeks with reports; no coding skills

phrasing_notes: polite but desperate; says he will go crazy repeating manual checks
answer_summary: Latest add-on can batch-process IFCs and IDS with per-file reports; GSoC IfcTester web app sample suggested; docs mostly in tests.

gloss_en: How to view an IDS XML as simple human-readable text like in a conference demo

answer_summary: Use IfcTester web app (Flask) locally or CLI; Bonsai cannot author IDS yet.
